collector_issue: Payment acknowledgement classifier used unquote instead of form-query parsing; plus-encoded Payment+successful was not recognized.
treatment: Do not use those fields as payment acknowledgement or failure truth. Preserve originals. Ledger counts, unique amounts, timings, HTTP status, traces and instrumentation snapshots are retained independently.
request_to_ledger_link: Each request uses a unique transfer amount and UUID in this isolated run. Ledger matching uses exact sender, receiver and amount.
future_correction: Parse query parameters with urllib.parse.parse_qs and retain the decoded result_message; no retrospective invention of missing query strings.
trace_coverage: Frontend server/client only. Backend and SQL spans not claimed.
